scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build:cloudflare
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:instance: npm run config && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.instance.json && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.instance.json

DB.description: Stores profiles, passkey public keys, workouts and body weight. Everything openGym knows about you lives here — **back it up**.

RP_ID.description: The bare hostname passkeys are bound to, e.g. `gym.example.com` — no scheme, no path. **Changing it later invalidates every passkey already registered.** A `*.workers.dev` hostname works for a look but cannot be moved off later ([why](https://github.com/rcnsh/opengym/blob/main/worker/README.md#why-you-need-a-domain)).

ORIGIN.description: The full URL the app is served from, e.g. `https://gym.example.com` — same host as `RP_ID`, with the scheme and no trailing slash.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs session cookies. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Losing it signs everyone out; it is never shown again, so keep a copy.

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Public half of the Web Push key pair, for rest-timer alerts and workout reminders. Generate both halves with `npx web-push generate-vapid-keys`. Leave blank to run without push.

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private half of the same pair. Losing it kills every existing push subscription.

ADMIN_UIDS.description: Comma-separated user ids that get the admin dashboard. Leave blank — you cannot know your own id until you have registered. Set it afterwards; see [Create the first account](https://github.com/rcnsh/opengym/blob/main/worker/README.md#create-the-first-account).
